observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a cream/off-white mechanical sewing machine head, vintage style, sitting directly on a patterned floor tile.
No cabinet, table, or foot pedal visible in either photo.
A small plate with text is visible on the top of the machine in photo 1, but it is too blurry to read clearly.
No power cord, foot controller, or motor assembly clearly visible.
No photo of the machine running, stitching, or threaded.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and a seller name overlay the images; these are platform/text artifacts, not proof of the machine's condition.

claims.claim: Solid New Home vintage sewing machine
claims.evidence: Nameplate in photo 1 is too blurry to confirm 'New Home' brand; no readable logo or model tag in either photo.

claims.claim: More than a basic [machine] (implied extra features)
claims.evidence: No photo shows internal mechanism, stitch selector detail, or accessories that would substantiate added features.

risks.risk: Machine may not power on or motor may be seized/non-functional
risks.proof: A video clip of the machine running with foot pedal engaged and needle moving

risks.risk: Foot pedal, power cord, and motor may be missing or not included in sale
risks.proof: A photo showing the pedal, cord, and motor attached or included alongside the machine

risks.risk: Brand/model cannot be confirmed, affecting comparable value
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the nameplate/badge on the machine
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic unbranded vintage sewing machine

risks.risk: Hidden rust, corrosion, or mechanical wear on moving parts not visible under current lighting
risks.proof: Well-lit close-up photos of the bobbin area, feed dogs, and underside of the machine

risks.risk: No table/cabinet included, which is standard with many vintage machines and affects usability
risks.proof: Photo showing the full setup including table/cabinet if being sold together

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the nameplate/badge to confirm brand and model
Video of the machine powered on and stitching
Photo showing foot pedal, power cord, and motor included
Well-lit photos of the underside and moving parts for rust/wear check
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a vintage mechanical sewing machine, but brand, completeness, and working condition are all unverified from the photos, so it must be priced at worst case (non-working, head-only, unbranded) until proof is supplied.
